change_control.reason: Open object-level DEV physical rollouts show corrected bottom control but underfit PADP grasp/action generation; 50k consumed only about 3.5 row epochs

method.representation: official PA3FF architecture and released representation code; frozen Sonata backbone; frozen 10000-step PA3FF instance head
method.padp: paper-equivalent local reconstruction because PADP training/inference source was not released
method.point_conditioning: 1024 object points -> frozen PA3FF 768D point features -> 4-layer Transformer with frozen normalized SigLIP part CLS token
method.task_conditioning: frozen normalized SigLIP instruction embedding plus 9D current pre-action robot proprioception
method.action_policy: Diffusion-Policy-style conditional 1D U-Net, H=16, A=10, DDPM training and DDIM inference

data.adapter_change: only initial_robot_proprioception changed to frozen pre-action HOME qpos; every point-cloud, action, camera, split, and supervision array is unchanged
data.split: object-level; TRAIN, DEV, and global formal object unions are pairwise disjoint; global formal objects are excluded from every TRAIN and DEV task

formal_training.initialization: exact continuation from V1 step030000 through frozen V2 step050000, including model, optimizer, scaler, row stream, and RNG
formal_training.resume_rule: first start accepts only the metadata-rebased, tensor-exact V2 step050000 parent; subsequent resume accepts exact V3 optimizer/scaler/stream/RNG checkpoint
formal_training.numeric_precision: FP32 from step50001 because the V2 log records 8951 nonfinite AMP forwards that were already replayed in FP32

dev_selection.primary_metric: mean clean-action x0 normalized MSE over the fixed DEV examples and high-noise timesteps 75,90,95,99
dev_selection.rationale: DDIM inference starts at t=99; the V1 aggregate metric hid much larger t>=75 error while step030000 DEV was still improving

paper_training_volume: the released material does not specify a reproducible PADP optimizer-step count; historical local plan was 100000 updates
budget_rationale: The extra 30k updates are justified before training by continued high-noise DEV improvement and only ~3.5 row epochs at 50k.  No formal result selects the stopping point.
